name: Mrinal Iswarari
bio: Primary composer and lyricist for Songs of Salvation (Sonadoba N.E.L.C.), dedicated to creating heartfelt Christian hymns and spiritual songs in local and regional languages.

name: Alen Mochari
bio: Renowned lyricist and co-creator of uplifting worship anthems, collaborating closely with the Sonadoba ministry to spread the gospel through music.

name: Alex Iswarari
bio: Dedicated songwriter and musical arranger contributing spiritual hymns and inspiring melodies to the Songs of Salvation anthology.

name: Protensing Narjinari
bio: Passionate hymnist and composer contributing traditional and contemporary worship compositions to enrich church fellowship and devotion.
